source.title: Preparing a remote team handover
source.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
source.article: Before the project lead leaves for annual leave, she will hand over the client schedule to her colleague. They will go over the open tasks in a short video call and flag any deadline that may change. The colleague will keep track of new requests in the shared log and follow up with the design team if a file is missing. A clear handover helps everyone know who is responsible while the lead is away.
